title: Authorized manual-fulfillment charge candidate
purpose: Derive one immutable authorized fulfillment-charge candidate from one exact FOOD-005N policy decision requiring manual approval and one exact FOOD-005M positive manual fulfillment approval, bound to one exact requested FOOD-005E physical-order version and one exact FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent snapshot.
whyNow: FOOD-005N now explicitly decides whether manual fulfillment approval is required.
FOOD-005M records exact positive approval and approvedAdditionalFee when manual approval occurs.
FOOD-005M explicitly defers proof that its approved fee is represented in an exact payable assessment.
Checkout/payment readiness remains premature until required manual-approved fee authority can be carried toward FOOD-005J without inventing fee values.

contract.derivation: This is a pure derived candidate, not a separately caller-minted identity/version family.
contract.orderBinding: Exact FOOD-005E physical-order ID/version. Derivation requires the exact order state to remain requested; cancelled historical evidence cannot create a new charge candidate.
contract.fulfillmentBinding: Exact FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent ID/version plus method, locationReference and windowReference.
contract.policyBinding: Exact FOOD-005N decision ID/version bound to the same order/fulfillment sources. manualApprovalRequirement must equal required.
contract.approvalBinding: Exact FOOD-005M approval ID/version bound to the same order/fulfillment sources.
contract.money: Candidate money is copied exactly from FOOD-005M approvedAdditionalFee. Zero remains valid because FOOD-005M permits zero.
contract.provenance: Preserve FOOD-005N policy attribution/policyReference/decidedOn and FOOD-005M approval attribution/sourceReference/approvedOn.
contract.immutability: Return detached frozen candidate and frozen nested snapshots.
contract.purity: No database, filesystem, network, clock, provider, payment initiation or persistence.

invariants: manual approval evidence + required policy != payable assessment inclusion
cancelled order historical approval != charge authorization
deferred: proof that an exact FOOD-005J assessment includes this authorized candidate
atomic inventory/slot persistence and race protection

future.assessmentConstruction: A later trusted service may translate the exact authorized candidate into one explicit FOOD-005J charge adjustment while preserving source provenance.
future.assessmentValidation: A later seam may prove that one exact FOOD-005J assessment actually contains the required authorized charge candidate.
future.readiness: A later readiness projection may require that proof whenever FOOD-005N says manual approval is required.
